title: sorbus mougeotii var. anglica
intro: Sorbus mougeotii var. anglica, commonly known as the English Whitebeam, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the UK. It is known for its white flowers and red berries, which have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits. The berries of Sorbus mougeotii var. anglica contain bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and anthocyanins, which have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The berries have also been used to treat various health conditions, including diarrhea, fever, and respiratory issues, due to their antidiarrheal, antipyretic, and expectorant properties.
